purpose: Execute the predeclared eligible trace pool and controlled scalability grid without selecting instances from solver outcomes.

comparison.selection_rule: The 24 windows fixed by the original hash-ranked data protocol; no reselection after solver results.

mapping_sensitivity.scenarios: all nine original association-cost pairs per window
mapping_sensitivity.base_gamma_one: Reuse original input and its exact optimum; it is not a new independent instance.
mapping_sensitivity.arithmetic: Decimal precision 50; gamma=.5 via sqrt; gamma=2 via multiplication; final quantize to 10 decimal places ROUND_HALF_EVEN
mapping_sensitivity.gamma_one_validation: All 144 window-product values must equal original pilot quantized values.
mapping_sensitivity.quality_order_check: Check all 72 window-gamma vectors before solver execution; retain audit and stop on a failed strict order rather than silently deleting or resampling.
mapping_sensitivity.costs_and_buyers: Identical to paired original base instance; no change to costs, counts, theta or permissions.

scaling.coordinate_deduplication: The common center (32,4,9) is generated once per seed and cost profile and reused in all three axis plots.
scaling.quality_generator: Draw Q independent integer increments uniformly from 1..9 using random.Random(seed); cumulative sums divided by total; alpha_Q=1.
scaling.buyer_generator: B permission caps ceil(j*Q/B), j=1..B; T-1 equally spaced positive theta values from 1 to 4; all B*(T-1) combinations; count=512/(B*(T-1)), required integer.
scaling.association: independent, exact uniform permission and theta marginals
scaling.cost_rng: Seed is big-endian integer from first eight SHA256 bytes of UTF-8 sec6-scaling-cost-v1|seed|profile. Independent integer-uniform multipliers 950..1050 divided by1000 are drawn activation then service for each q.
scaling.cost_coordinates: x=q/Q; y=(q-1)/(Q-1) for Q>1, otherwise y=0
scaling.cost_interpretation: New controlled normalized-position profiles keep ranges comparable as Q varies; scenario costs, not measured expenditures or unchanged original trace formulas.
scaling.precision: All synthetic parameters use exact rational arithmetic.

execution.memory_enforcement: Monitor resident memory RSS; do not set 2GiB RLIMIT_AS because numerical libraries may map larger virtual regions.
execution.optimization_budget_semantics: MILP model construction is included in the total 5-second optimization budget; its internal solve time limit is the remaining budget max(0,5-build_seconds). Exact and heuristic solvers use the same 5-second cooperative optimization budget. Report input parsing, model construction, optimization, final reconstruction and replay separately; completion overhead beyond the optimization budget is flagged explicitly.
execution.hard_wall_semantics: Isolated job worker has hard10s including setup/final recovery/replay; bulk worker records per-job wall and must apply equivalent termination protection.
execution.statuses: Retain successful, timeout with/without incumbent, replay failure, memory limit and error records. Never drop a configuration because of outcome.
execution.precision: PHT and heuristic pricing/replay use exact rational arithmetic. MILP uses numerical optimization followed by independent exact difference-constraint price recovery and canonical choice replay. Retain both raw and restored candidates, the numerical objective, solver status and gap, and actual replay profit. Only a successfully exact-replayed candidate may be reported as a feasible incumbent; the weak incentive-compatibility objective is never treated as actual canonical-choice profit without replay.
execution.method_timing: Identical semantic timing fields; no warm-start from another method or previous instance optimum. Shared predeclared input preprocessing may be reported separately.
execution.cpu_threads: One computational thread per isolated job; fixed CPU per instance with repeated methods on same CPU when affinity available.
execution.timing_comparability: Bulk real/gamma throughput is pipeline validation only. Isolated benchmarking supplies method comparisons; never pool their wall times.
execution.rss: Record peak RSS per isolated worker and the scope of bulk-process peaks explicitly.
execution.source_reproducibility: Record source/protocol/input/solver hashes and execution environment in run manifest.

aggregation.real_unit: Source meter is the cluster; nine scenario combinations are paired simulation scenarios, not nine independent observed markets.
aggregation.real_profit: Compare algorithms on identical input. For exact OPT>0 report relative profit loss (OPT-value)/OPT. For OPT=0 report the absolute difference OPT-value separately; add no epsilon or artificial denominator floor. Retain unresolved/timeouts and coverage.
aggregation.real_equal_weight: Within each association-cost stratum, summarize windows within each meter first, then weight meters equally. Report numbers of meters/windows/scenarios separately.
aggregation.mapping: Compare gamma values within the same meter-month-association-cost block; stratify cost and association.
aggregation.synthetic_timing: For a fixed instance-method, summarize three timing repetitions by median and retain all repetitions and statuses; then compare the three seeds within each cost profile and scaling coordinate.
aggregation.timeouts: Report completion fractions and budget-censored times separately; do not remove failures or replace them with exact completion times.
aggregation.capacity: Report V(0)..V(6), cap needed to reach unrestricted optimum, and relative loss; no presupposed positive gap.
aggregation.uncertainty: If confidence intervals are drawn for real scenarios, resample source meters as clusters, retaining paired windows/scenarios. Synthetic repetitions are execution repeats, not independent generated instances.

result_policy: All predeclared inputs/jobs and all execution statuses are retained. Protocol version and SHA are fixed before formal solver execution; any later protocol change uses a new version and records its rationale.
interpretation: UCI traces supply technical quality variation. Reference monetary conversion, buyer theta/count/permissions and costs remain declared scenarios; no real transaction willingness-to-pay or negotiation benefit claim.
